{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Focus on converted == 1
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Now, exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
converted_valid = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print("Number of converted customers (converted == 1):", len(converted_df))
print("Number of converted customers with age -1:", (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())
print("Number of valid converted customers (age != -1):", len(converted_valid))
print("Mean age of valid converted customers:", mean_age_converted)"}
